after: ## Core (125 hours, both SL and HL)
alt: Two stacked bars. SL, 150 hours: core 125 and engagement project 25. HL, 240 hours: core 125, engagement project 35 and HL extension 80.
caption: The 125-hour core is identical at SL and HL.

after: ## Core (125 hours, both SL and HL)
alt: Four concepts, power, sovereignty, legitimacy and interdependence, sit above the three thematic studies and feed into each: rights and justice, development and sustainability, and peace and conflict. All three studies are compulsory at SL and HL.
caption: Every student studies all three themes and applies the four concepts in each.

after: ## Internal assessment -- engagement project (25 hours SL / 35 hours HL)
alt: Side-by-side columns. SL: 25 hours, a written report on a political issue of up to 2,000 words, marked on criteria A to E. HL: 35 hours, the same report up to 2,000 words, plus further research and a separate recommendation of up to 400 words assessed by an extra criterion F worth 6 marks.
caption: HL adds a real extra task: a recommendation, marked by criterion F.

after: ## HL extension only -- Global political challenges (80 hours, HL only)
alt: The 80-hour HL-only extension is independent research into cases the student selects, linked to eight topic areas: borders, environment, equality, health, identity, poverty, security and technology. Students research at least two case studies across at least two topic areas, examined in Paper 3, worth 30% of the HL grade.
caption: At least two cases, in at least two topic areas, for a paper worth 30%.
